spec.v: BTT Octopus V1.1, STM32F446, USB-to-CAN bridge
CoreXY, 0.9° A/B motors, TMC2209, 9000 mm/s² max
X mzv 68.2 Hz · Y ei 69.4 Hz
SSR on HE1, max_power 0.6, adaptive mesh
GIT_BACKUP → GitHub (deploy key) · restore points + SD image on the Mac

log.title: Fluidd theme: TRIDENT
log.body: Custom theme in .fluidd-theme/ matching this site: CRT scanlines, JetBrains Mono, Akira-red title, brass card headers, wolf logo. Remove the folder to go back to stock.

log.title: Toolhead build started
log.body: Converting the Stealthburner to a CAN toolhead board. Deciding between the Mellow FLY SB2040 V3 (pins match the Hartk 2-piece PCB) and the BTT SB2209 RP2040 (officially supported by Cartographer via the SB0000 adapter).

log.title: Test results saved: PID and mesh
log.body: Home, Z tilt, PID, pressure advance and bed mesh all passed. CAN bus clean through all tests: 0 errors, 0 drops.

log.title: macOS metadata file removed from the repo
log.body: ._* and .DS_Store now ignored.

log.title: PID_EXTRUDER / PID_BED buttons restored
log.body: Each has a TARGET field in Fluidd and saves the result.

log.title: Switched to the official fluidd-config
log.body: fluidd.cfg now links to ~/fluidd-config/client.cfg and updates through Moonraker. CANCEL_PRINT now retracts, parks and clears the mesh.

log.title: IggyTheWolf logo header in printer.cfg
log.body: Regenerated from the original image at the correct character aspect.

log.title: printer.cfg restyled
log.body: Boxed section headers, dead commented options and the unused chamber thermistor removed, adxl.cfg include moved to the top. Parsed settings compared before and after: identical apart from the intended changes.

log.title: macros.cfg tidied
log.body: Dead code and one-line wrappers removed, CASELIGHT VALUE= replaces LEDON/LEDOFF, PURGE_FILAMENT and PA_CAL cleaned up, [bed_mesh] moved to printer.cfg.

log.title: KAMP replaced by Klipper's built-in adaptive mesh
log.body: BED_MESH_CALIBRATE ADAPTIVE=1 with adaptive_margin 0. KAMP files, includes and the repo on the Pi removed.

log.title: PRINT_START: Tap probe temp named PROBE_TEMP
nozzle_scrub.cfg cut from 229 to 27 lines
log.body: Same wipe: X186 ↔ X226 at Y310, 8 passes.

log.title: PID macros fixed
log.body: SAVE_CONFIG shared a line with TURN_OFF_HEATERS and never ran, and the TARGET_TEMP parameter was ignored.

log.title: PA_CAL: deprecated ACCEL_TO_DECEL replaced
log.body: Now MINIMUM_CRUISE_RATIO=0.5.

log.title: [mcu] moved from serial to canbus_uuid 844419e24ade
log.body: Old serial and restart_method lines kept as comments for rollback.

log.title: can0 network interface on the Pi
log.body: /etc/network/interfaces.d/can0: 1 Mbit, txqueuelen 128, comes up on boot. Octopus shows as a gs_usb CAN adapter, state ERROR-ACTIVE.

log.title: Octopus flashed as USB-to-CAN bridge
log.body: STM32F446, 12 MHz, 32 KiB bootloader, USB on PA11/PA12, CAN on PD0/PD1 at 1 Mbit. The first build had CAN on PB8/PB9 and was caught before flashing. Needed a full power cycle to take the new firmware.

log.title: Post-update restore point
log.body: Taken after a 14 minute test print. Includes both Octopus firmware builds.

log.title: moonraker.conf: update channel set to stable
Octopus reflashed v0.10.0 → v0.13.0 (USB)
log.body: Board had been running 2022 firmware. Flashed firmware.bin from a microSD card; that card now stays in the Octopus so later flashes can be done remotely.

log.title: Klipper stack updated
log.body:
Klipper v0.12.0-249 → v0.13.0
Moonraker v0.8.0 → v0.11.0 (database migrated, stats intact)
Fluidd 1.30.0 → 1.37.6
Obico 2.0.1 → 2.2.3
crowsnest 4.1.9 → 4.2.0
Config checked against every v0.13 breaking change: no edits needed.

log.title: System packages upgraded
log.body: 201 apt packages upgraded on Raspbian 11 bullseye. No kernel change, no reboot needed. Moonraker update channel switched from dev to stable.

log.title: Full SD card image
log.body: 32 GB card imaged to voron-sd-2026-09-29.img.gz (3.3 GB). gzip test passed and the uncompressed size matches the card byte for byte. Restore steps in RESTORE.md.

log.title: Rollback firmware built for the Octopus
log.body: USB-mode firmware for Klipper v0.12.0-249 saved in ~/Voron-Backups/firmware. Found the Pi's saved build settings were for an SB2209 RP2040 on CAN; kept as sb2209-rp2040-can.config.

log.title: GitHub config backup rebuilt
log.body: The old repo on the Pi was gone and .autocommit.sh still pointed at ~/klipper_config. New SSH deploy key limited to this repo, rewritten backup script that refuses database files and the Obico token, new .gitignore. Existing GitHub history kept.

log.title: First restore point pulled to the Mac
log.body: Config folder (symlinks resolved), Moonraker database snapshot, Octopus firmware settings and KIAUH settings, saved to the Mac outside Dropbox. Database snapshot checked and intact.
